## What's new in 1.21.5

This update makes the Focus mini player reliable, adds support for right-to-left writing, and makes the list window easier to use.

### Focus mini player

- The mini player can no longer be maximised or made full screen. Before, a double-click or the window buttons could stretch it over the whole screen, always on top, with no way to close it.
- Its close button now works every time, and so do Esc and Alt+F4.
- Once you detach it with the pin, it becomes your only player for the session, inside Aqueli and everywhere else. You no longer see two players at once.
- It stays where you put it, even when you start a new session or change its size.
- It now comes in three sizes: compact, standard and large. Its size button switches between them, and Aqueli remembers your choice.
- The thin bar that could show above it is gone.
- Quick capture (Ctrl+Alt+A) still opens normally while the mini player is shown.

### Right-to-left writing

- Text now follows its own direction. A field, a title or a paragraph that starts in Arabic, Hebrew or Persian is written and aligned right to left as you type.
- Ctrl+Right Shift and Ctrl+Left Shift work like in other Windows apps. They switch the current field, or the current note paragraph, to right-to-left or left-to-right.
- In notes and the journal, the direction you choose is saved with the note.

### Lists

- The window for creating or editing a list now uses two columns. It fits on screen without scrolling, buttons included.

## Install

Download `Aqueli_1.21.5_x64-setup.exe` below and run it. It installs Aqueli for your Windows user account, without administrator rights, and keeps your data from the previous version.

The installer is not code-signed yet: if Windows SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway.
